item.title: Topological Quantum Error-Correcting Thresholds of a Symmetry-Enriched Toric Code
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jiasheng He, Ryan Thorngren
arXiv:2610.37791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the error thresholds of a new topological quantum error-correcting code under the independent bit-flip and phase-flip noisy channel. By mapping to classical spin-glass models, we find that if Pauli X and Z errors are equally probable, the threshold of vertex syndromes is improved by 30% compared to that of the toric code, while the threshold of plaquette syndromes is lowered. Both thresholds increase when the Z component is less likely than the X component, reaching 0.5 if the Z component is absent. An analytical proof justifies this special case of perfect correctability, and a disordered version of Peierls's argument establishes a lower bound for the vertex-syndrome threshold.

item.title: Quantum Foundations Beyond Bell's Theorem: A Topical Review
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Flavio Del Santo, Nicolas Gisin
arXiv:2610.37854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We review a series of recent no-go theorems that extend the methodological and conceptual framework introduced by Bell's theorem to more sophisticated operational scenarios involving independent sources, quantum networks, joint measurements, and multiple observers. Many of these results were originally developed within quantum information science and are scattered across the literature, where their technical and application-driven success has partly obscured their broader foundational significance. We organize them around a common Bell-inspired methodology that extends beyond quantum nonlocality, and emphasize how increasingly rich operational structures change which physical assumptions can be tested.

item.title: 采用广义密度矩阵形式对开放量子自旋系统进行精确正P模拟
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Alex Ferrier, Yi Shi, Marzena H. Szymańska, Piotr Deuar
正P表示法为玻色子提供了可扩展的精确模拟开放量子多体系统的方法，但将其推广到自旋系统仍具挑战性。本文开发了一种新的相空间表示，将自旋-1/2自由度映射到局部广义密度矩阵（GDM）的参数上，而非SU(2)相干态。该方法在所有稳定状态下均未显示出与精确解的偏差，恢复了正P特性。GDM表示法可与玻色子正P无缝结合，实现对耦合自旋-玻色子系统的高度可扩展处理。

item.title: 在超导量子处理器上实验观测错误弹性相变
item.description:

item.title: 通过无损动力学设计有益耗散实现量子优势
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zeng-Zhao Li, Xiao Xue

item.title: 基于超纠缠的量子隐私放大实现光纤网络中经典-量子共存
item.description:

👤 Domenico Ribezzo, Giulia Guarda, Alessandro Zavatta, Davide Bacco

item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Franciszek Grzywa, Sebastian Dolata, Karol Bartkiewicz

item.description:

👤 Akira Sone, Maxim Olshanii

item.title: 广义平均场伊辛模型：具有精确解的基准族

item.title: 无扩展的局部量子容错
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 David Ponarovsky

A central challenge in achieving QKD over long distances is overcoming optical loss, which limits the secret key rates and achievable transmission distances. Recent work has illustrated how to perform continuous variable quantum key distribution while eliminating information leakage to an eavesdropper in a pure-loss channel and minimizing information leakage in a noisy channel. In this work, we analyse this protocol under conditions where the quantum channel linking the sender and receiver is a fading channel, which can be used to model free-space links.
